series.name: Table C — Axpert MKS II 5KVA
series.notes: Faults 10/11/12 with MKS II meanings (10=PV over current, 11=PV over voltage, 12=DC/DC over current) — collides with older MKS service 11 and differs from Infini titles.

meaning.en: PV input current over limit (MKS II meaning; InfiniSolar fault 10 = 'PV current over' — same idea, different title).
meaning.ur: PV input current had se zyada (MKS II InfiniSolar 10 = 'PV current over')

causes.en: PV array oversized with more parallel strings than the rating.
causes.ur: PV array zyada bada hai, rating se zyada parallel strings hain.

causes.en: Water or dust causing leakage current in the DC wiring.
causes.ur: Paani ya dhool ki wajah se DC wiring mein leakage current hai.

solutions.en: Switch off the PV DC isolator, wait 5 minutes, then check the array strings for damaged panels, water or loose DC connectors.
solutions.ur: Pehle PV DC isolator band karein, 5 minute ruk kar array strings check karein ke panels kharab, paani ya DC connectors dheele to nahin.

solutions.en: Confirm the array size is within the unit input rating; reduce parallel strings if it is oversized, then restart.
solutions.ur: Check karein ke array size unit ki input rating ke andar hai; agar zyada bada hai to parallel strings kam kar ke restart karein.

solutions.en: If the fault returns with a correct array, have the DC input stage checked at the service centre.
solutions.ur: Sahi array ke sath bhi fault wapas aaye, to DC input stage ko service centre se check karwayein.

source.title: Voltronic Power Axpert MKS II 5KVA manual-20190703 (official)

notes.en: Roadmap said Table A has fault 10 — true for MKS II/MKS III, **not** for official VM III (01–09 only). Platform reference entry (table source SRC-MKSII). Local brand rows may match but keep brand code space separate.
notes.ur: Roadmap mein likha tha Table A mein fault 10 hai — yeh MKS II/MKS III ke liye sahi hai, official VM III ke liye **nahin** (01–09 only). Yeh platform ka reference entry hai (table source SRC-MKSII). Local brand ki rows mil sakti hain, magar brand ka code space alag rakhein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon lit; red LED solid; continuous buzzer.

meaning.en: PV input voltage over limit (MKS II).
meaning.ur: PV input voltage had se zyada (MKS II)

causes.en: PV string Voc too high (too many modules in series).
causes.ur: PV string Voc zyada (series mein modules zyada).

causes.en: Cold morning Voc rise pushed the string above the limit.
causes.ur: Thandi subah Voc badal kar string ko limit se upar le gaya.

causes.en: Wrong array specification selected for this model.
causes.ur: Is model ke liye ghalat array specification choose ki gayi.

solutions.en: Turn off the PV DC isolator before touching any DC cable, then measure the string Voc with a meter.
solutions.ur: DC cable chhoone se pehle PV DC isolator band karein, phir meter se string ka Voc naapein.

solutions.en: Reduce the number of PV modules in series so the Voc stays within the unit limit, then power up and retest.
solutions.ur: Voc unit ki limit ke andar rahe ke liye series mein PV modules ki tadad kam kar ke unit on kar ke dobara test karein.

solutions.en: Check panels for damage and connectors for burning; replace any faulty panel or connector before re-energising.
solutions.ur: Panels mein kharabi aur connectors mein jalne ke nishan check karein; dobara power se pehle kharab panel ya connector badal dein.

source.title: Voltronic Power Axpert MKS II 5KVA manual-20190703 (official)

notes.en: COLLISION: older MKS service fault 11 = 'Main relay failed' (SRC-MKSSVC); InfiniSolar fault 11 = 'PV voltage over' (same as MKS II). Platform reference entry (table source SRC-MKSII). Local brand rows may match but keep brand code space separate.
notes.ur: COLLISION: purane MKS service fault 11 = 'Main relay failed' (SRC-MKSSVC); InfiniSolar fault 11 = 'PV voltage over' (MKS II ke jaisa hi). Yeh platform ka reference entry hai (table source SRC-MKSII). Local brand ki rows mil sakti hain, magar brand ka code space alag rakhein.

codes.blinkPattern: Fault icon lit; red LED solid; continuous buzzer.

meaning.en: DC/DC stage over-current (MKS II; InfiniSolar fault 12 = 'Charge current over').
meaning.ur: DC/DC stage par over-current (MKS II; InfiniSolar fault 12 = 'Charge current over').

causes.en: Battery bank too small for the charge current.
causes.ur: Charge current ke muqable battery bank chhota hai.

causes.en: DC/DC stage component degraded over time.
causes.ur: DC/DC stage ka component waqt ke sath kamzor ho gaya.

solutions.en: Isolate AC input and PV, then check the battery bank size and wiring — a small bank or loose DC link causes the over-current.
solutions.ur: AC input aur PV alag kar ke battery bank ki size aur wiring check karein — chhota bank ya dheela DC link over-current la sakta hai.

solutions.en: Measure the battery voltage and DC link with a meter after reconnecting, restart the unit and watch the current.
solutions.ur: Dobara connect kar ke meter se battery voltage aur DC link naapein, unit restart karein aur current par nazar rakhein.

solutions.en: If the fault repeats with a correct battery and array, the DC/DC stage needs service — return the unit to the repair centre.
solutions.ur: Sahi battery aur array ke sath bhi fault dobara aaye, to DC/DC stage ki service zaroori hai — unit ko repair centre le jayein.

source.title: Voltronic Power Axpert MKS II 5KVA manual-20190703 (official)
